top_stories.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD
top_stories.description: Meta has detailed TLX, its Triton Low-Level Extensions that add warp-group, barrier, TMA and cluster control to Python Triton kernels. It runs Meta's ads and LLM workloads on Hopper, Blackwell and AMD MI350 GPUs. The post Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD appeared first on MarkTechPost.

top_stories.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
top_stories.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. The article GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy appeared first on The Decoder.

top_stories.title: QUICK SPARK: Jensen Huang Is Back — Nvidia Stock Is Having Its Best Day Since 2003
top_stories.description: Last week, Jensen Huang‘s exit dragged Nvidia stock into its worst week since 2008. On Monday, his return is driving one of the best days in its history. NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) shares rose 30.8% to $164.19 by early afternoon in New York, after the board voted to reinstate Huang as chief executive. top_stories.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
top_stories.description: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has released internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT series for the first time, up to an unreleased model beyond the current generation. The metric shows that core capabilities emerge at surprisingly precise thresholds. Pachocki is pushing to make perplexity an industry-wide progress metric and establish shared limits before control over AI behavior erodes.
